method.model: Holt damped additive trend (ETS A,Ad,N); OLS linear-trend fallback
method.validation: Holdout of the final 2–3 annual observations; MAPE and RMSE reported per series.
method.intervals: 80% empirical residual intervals, widening with sqrt(horizon).
method.eligibility: >=8 consecutive annual observations; last observation in 2021 or later; completed holdout validation.
method.scenario: baseline_trend — no policy or technology scenario is assumed.

notes: Forecasts are model outputs, not observations.
Series with insufficient history, gaps, or a last observation before 2021 are not forecast.
Intervals reflect historical residual uncertainty only; they do not include structural breaks or policy change.
